L7CarPlay connects through the vehicle hotspot “%1$s”. Turn it on in vehicle settings before connecting.
Allow Nearby devices for L7CarPlay in the vehicle app permissions.
Allow L7CarPlay to access nearby devices so it can connect to your paired iPhone.
Allow precise location for L7CarPlay in the vehicle app permissions.
Could not start CarPlay. Return to L7CarPlay and check app permissions.
In CarPlay, swipe down with three fingers to open L7CarPlay settings.
Choose the language for L7CarPlay. System default follows the device language.
On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth and pair with the vehicle. Return to L7CarPlay and select Connect iPhone.
Return from vehicle settings to L7CarPlay and connect. Accept the CarPlay prompt on your iPhone. A vehicle data plan is not required; mobile data availability depends on your phone network settings.

1. Open vehicle hotspot settings, turn the hotspot on and select 5 GHz if available.\n2. Copy the hotspot name and password exactly below.\n3. Keep the vehicle hotspot on while connecting. L7CarPlay sends the details over Bluetooth and your iPhone joins automatically.
